# SWMM engine attribution

`swmmwasm-0.0.4.js` is an unmodified copy from the npm package `@fileops/swmm-wasm-web@0.0.4`, author Issac Gardner, declared license MIT. The package embeds the EPA SWMM 5.2.2 solver compiled to WebAssembly.

Package source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fileops/swmm-wasm-web/v/0.0.4

EPA engine source: https://github.com/USEPA/Stormwater-Management-Model

This software is not endorsed or certified by EPA. Report metrics retain the engine's printed precision. Browser results are client-executed, not independently server-verified.
